answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch polynomial commitment and prove membership in a Semaphore-style tree without disclosing identity. Rate-limiting nullifiers bind each message to an epoch and quota; repeating a nullifier yields distinct Shamir shares whose interpolation exposes the private key, enabling verification and immediate collateral slashing. This makes Sybil identities costly, whether they gather like orchard fruit, cluster as walnut shells, or spread across a tundra.
